Duplicate bug report, can probably be merged.

According to the logs, you are using a Dell XPS 8930. It comes with a "10/100/1000 Mbps Killer Ethernet controller integrated on system board" ([XPS 8930 Setup and Specifications](https://dl.dell.com/topicspdf/xps-8930-desktop_setup-guide_en-us.pdf) PDF, pg. 15). You are also experiencing the same "Unable to complete SSL connection" error as in the following tracked Canny: [Cant load images or most avatars](https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/cant-load-images-or-most-avatars)

Please end your Intel Killer Network services task and report if the issue persists.

For support in general, contact https://vrch.at/support.

> Stopped and disabled Killer Network Service — no effect

Sorry I missed that.

details:
Platform: PC, Windows 10, Ethernet connection

Problems experienced:

Attempting to join any world or friend instance would fail and send me back to the default VRChat home world. Avatars, VRC+ profile pictures, group banners, instance pictures, and world thumbnails frequently fail to load and display "No Image" or an error. The only workaround found for avatars was toggling the max download size and max uncompressed size settings in Avatar Optimizations to 0 MB and back to force a retry.

Log file error (output_log_2026-04-21_01-16-43.txt):

The log shows repeated SSL failures as the root cause:

[Image Download] Unable to complete SSL connection on assets.vrchat.com and api.vrchat.cloud

[AssetBundleDownloadManager] Asset bundle request failed: result=2 code=0 error=Unable to complete SSL connection — this is what causes the world join failure and redirect to home world

schannel: failed to receive handshake, SSL/TLS connection failed

This started approximately 1.5 months ago with no changes made to my system.

Fixes attempted:

Stopped and disabled Killer Network Service — no effect

Cleared VRChat cache (in-game debug menu and Cache-WindowsPlayer folder)

Switched DNS to Google (8.8.8.8 / 8.8.4.4) and flushed DNS

Ran Windows Updates

Verified VRChat game files via Steam

Updated Windows root certificates via certutil -generateSSTFromWU and certutil -addstore

Enabled TLS 1.2 and 1.3 via Internet Options

Forced TLS 1.2 and 1.3 via registry (SCHANNEL)

Ran certutil -syncWithWU C:\certs — downloaded 512 certificates

Reset Windows network stack via netsh winsock reset and netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal

Set MTU to 1400 via netsh interface ipv4 set subinterface

Current status after fixes: World joining is partially working but still fails on some worlds (larger worlds and certain friend instances). Avatar, profile picture, group banner, and image loading is still intermittently broken. SSL handshake failures appear to still be occurring.
title: Lots of things are not loading.
